scientific_interpretation.tie_intervention: Controlled evidence that true-label tie orientation changes concentrated routing under fixed training and solver, not evidence of independent accuracy improvement
scientific_interpretation.uniform: Near-tied output scores and numerical instability preclude winner promotion
scientific_interpretation.stable_gaps: LOSO strata use same-question feedback and cannot certify input-only deployment; sparse supports and intervals retain negative evidence
scientific_interpretation.content: Matched one-shuffle control does not establish content dependence; feature masking is distribution-shifting and inherits the learned intercept
scientific_interpretation.power: Approximate planning conditional on historical OOF variance, specified effect and one-sided fixed-time test; not retained-set empirical power
